[Team group, Tuesday]
Megha: Team! Jaisa sabko pata hai Rajiv sir ka last day 28 ko hai. Unhone hum sab ke liye ITNA kuch kiya hai. Proper send-off karenge — ek achhi watch soch rahe hain, ₹5,000 per head, 12 log hain hum. Please isme kanjoosi mat karna 😄
Priyank: Done ✅
Sonal: in! honestly deserve karte hain sir
Ankit: great idea! 👏
Ankit: ek chhota sa thought — amounts flexible rakhein kya? jo jitna comfortable ho, card sabki taraf se same?
Megha: arre sirf 5k hai! ek weekend brunch 😄 fixed amount cleaner rehta hai, jo watch pasand ki hai usme poora pool chahiye
Ankit: makes sense. Friday tak confirm karta hoon!
[Friday]
Megha: final list kal store jaa rahi hai — Priyank, Sonal, Dhruv, Kavita done. kuch logon ka wait hai ✨
---
[DM, Friday raat]
Dhruv: bro tu in hai? Megha mujhse final list puchh rahi hai kyunki main tere bagal mein baithta hoon lol
Dhruv: btw woh farewell pe card ke saath naam padhne wali hai sabke

---
1. Ankit ke group wale chaar messages trace karo. Har ek asal mein kya kar raha hai, aur "flexible amounts" wale question se woh sach mein kya maang raha tha?
2. Megha ke "sirf 5k hai, ek weekend brunch" reply ne kya kiya — decision ke saath, aur Ankit ke saath specifically? "Final list" asal mein kya cheez ban gayi hai?
3. Ankit ka Dhruv ko reply likho, bilkul waisa jaisa use bhejna chahiye — jo uski izzat bhi rakhe, aur na ₹5,000 dene pade na apne paison ki safai.

Yahan conversation ke basis par tumhare questions ke jawab hain:

**1. Ankit ke group wale chaar messages ka trace:**
*   **"great idea! 👏"**: Ye ek simple approval/encouragement hai Rajiv sir ke send-off gift ke proposal par.
*   **"ek chhota sa thought — amounts flexible rakhein kya? jo jitna comfortable ho, card sabki taraf se same?"**: Ye asal mein Ankit ka attempt tha apni financial commitment kam karne ya avoid karne ka. Wo chahta tha ki ₹5,000 fixed na ho, balki har koi apni marzi se (kam ya zyada) de—iska matlab wo khud ₹5k se kam dena chahta tha ya us situation se bachna chahta tha jahan usko poora amount dena pade.
*   **"makes sense. Friday tak confirm karta hoon!"**: Jab Megha ne flexible amount reject kar diya, Ankit ne formally maan liya ki fixed ₹5k hi dena padega, aur usne commitment di ki wo Friday tak apni entry confirm karega.
*   *Note: Transcript mein Ankit ke exactly 4 messages hain: "great idea! 👏", "ek chhota sa thought...", "makes sense. Friday tak confirm karta hoon!" (ye do lines ek message mein hain per app screenshot ke hisab se alag count ho sakte hain, par content yahi hai).*

**2. Megha ke "sirf 5k hai, ek weekend brunch" reply ka asar:**
*   **Decision ke saath**: Isne 'fixed amount' wala rule final kar diya. Koi flexibility nahi rahi, ₹5,000 per head mandatory ho gaya (watch kharidne ke liye poora pool chahiye).
*   **Ankit ke saath specifically**: Isne Ankit ke "flexible amounts" wale suggestion ko directly shut down kar diya aur use force kiya ki wo bhi baaki 11 logon jitna hi (₹5k) hi contribute kare.
*   **"Final list" asal mein kya cheez ban gayi**: Ye list ab sirf naamon ki list nahi, balki **"confirmed contributors" (paisa dene walon)** ki list ban gayi hai. Megha ne Priyank, Sonal, Dhruv, Kavita ko "done" isliye mark kiya kyunki unka payment/commitment confirm ho gaya tha.

**3. Ankit ka Dhruv ko reply (jo uski izzat rakhe, ₹5k na dene de aur na hi safai de):**
> "Haan bhai, main hu. Megha ko bol dena main Friday tak apna part confirm kar dunga—abhi thoda kaam aur health ka chakkar chal raha hai, toh officially 'in' Friday ko hi bataunga. Tu unhe keh de main list mein naam toh mere bhi aana chahiye card ke liye, bas paisa Friday ko clear hoga. 👍"

*(Is reply se Ankit ne apna naam card par ensure kar liya, ₹5k dene se apne aap ko Friday tak delay kiya bina kisi kanjoosi ki safai diye, aur apni image 'busy/responsible' rakhi.)*
